oracle.invariant: S1: 202; the demo action's choice is template {quickstart: 'tracy-base/j6', design: 'tracy', version: '1.4.0', reason: 'pinned'}; then tracy-business/j6 with reason pinned. S2: default: the choice is ja-restaurant with reason 'pin-missing:tracy-base/j6;restaurant-match'; strict: 409 TEMPLATE_PIN_UNAVAILABLE {pin: 'tracy-base/j6', cms: 'joomla'} and no wo_demo_action row (nothing charged). S3: 400 INVALID_TEMPLATE both times and no wo_demo_action row; a template offered for Joomla is reason requested. S4: GET settings says wordpress; a wordpress build takes tracy-base/wp7; an emdash build reads cms emdash, cmsSource account, template tracy-base/emdash-0.x. S5: templateStatuses joomla found true offered false, wordpress found true offered true, emdash found false offered false. S6: 200 with the pins saved (an empty pin reads as the default) and the policy strict; 400 INVALID_PINNED_TEMPLATE or INVALID_TEMPLATE_PIN_POLICY for each junk value. S7: suggestedLabel pho-ba, then pho-ba-2; the build without a label (or blank) asks the create door for pho-ba-2 and answers build.label pho-ba-2; my-pho is sent as typed; Bad name! is refused INVALID_LABEL on the build and 42 answers 400 INVALID_LABEL at the demo door; the worker's retry asks the create door again for the same build with the name it chose first. siteLabelFor("Nhan's Kitchen", {cms: 'joomla', suffix: 'base'}) is nhans-kitchen-j-base. S8: GET build reads failed with receipt.failure {code: PROVISION_FAILED, reason}; the retry through the failed action asks the create door again with the same buildId and name and reads done; the same choice again answers 409 BUILD_EXISTS with the live build, no second demo action and no second site; another template builds a second demo of the same brief; once the first demo failed the same choice builds again; the stuck one reads failed REQUEST_LOST; the dead run settles within the first tick with timings.lost LOST_ON_RESTART instead of after 4 minutes. S9: round 2 reads the new nav; the drafted page is visited, not judged twice as home; footer and sitemap pages are judged; no-empty-picture-slots, placed-pictures-visible and no-google-review-quoted fail with page and selector; the hand-off prompt carries no Google review text; a plan row without a path is listed under unmatched, never a PAGE_PLAN_MISSING. The plan's kept pages are read (Joomla at /index.php/<route>) and judged — template prices on Simple Menu are flagged by facts-from-brief as sample content; a plan page that 404s is visited from plan, not judged, and reads PAGE_PLAN_MISSING; a deleted build does not answer BUILD_EXISTS.
